title: The Volume-to-Authority Transformation Pipeline
scopeLimits: Illustrates how unorganized buyer volume fails to generate bargaining power without representational and exit gates.
limitations: Conceptual model; not empirical econometric data.

accessibility.altText: A pipeline showing raw buyer volume passing through representation, ratification, and exit gates to achieve a genuine market position.
accessibility.textEquivalent: Unstructured volume without gates remains an atomized queue. When filtered through representational mandate, ratification, and credible exit floors, it converts into a countervailing market position.
